title: Admin Web Provider Depth Governance
problem: Durable Metadata Candidate Reviews and backend accepted-review application exist, but Admin API/Web must expose review evidence, application plans, and explicit apply mutations without conflating them with existing Provider Mapping row review or Generated Artifact apply workflows.
gates: JSONL validation for docs/workstreams/admin-web-provider-depth-governance/TASKS.jsonl, CAMPAIGNS.jsonl, and CONTEXT.jsonl
cargo nextest run -p nako-server candidate_review admin --no-fail-fast

evidence.summary: Opened the Admin/Web provider depth governance lane from ARPMA closeout and selected read-only Admin API Candidate Review detail/application-plan exposure as the first executable task.

Exposed redaction-safe read-only Admin API durable Metadata Candidate Review detail and accepted-review application plan facts without writing Provider Subject, Provider Mapping, Canonical Metadata, or related graph node state.

Added an explicit Admin API apply mutation for accepted durable Metadata Candidate Reviews that calls MetadataCandidateReviewApplicationService with stale guards, idempotency-key fingerprinting, replay visibility, and root-only Provider Subject / Provider Mapping application.

Added a Web Admin direct route for durable Metadata Candidate Review inspection and explicit accepted-review apply confirmation, with live/fixture data-source contracts, route-state coverage, idempotency-key handling, and preview-only related graph presentation.

architecture_refs.capability: Admin/Web provider depth governance active lane

continue_policy.notes: Next close the lane or split follow-ons for related-node hierarchy application, provider endpoint depth, and durable governance navigation/list surfaces. Keep Public Client API and schema migrations out unless a follow-on explicitly opens them.
